name: Critical Effects (BC): Impact - Leg
description: Black Crusade, Table 7-18 (p. 253). Look up the total Critical Damage. Mechanical effects only - read the full description from the rulebook.

results.text: Movement halved (rounding up) for 1 round. Challenging (+0) Toughness Test or Stunned for 1 round and knocked Prone.
Leg broken. Stunned for 1 round, knocked Prone, and Movement reduced to 1 metre until medical attention.
Immediate Challenging (+0) Toughness Test or permanently lose the use of the foot. Movement halved (rounding up) until medical attention. 2 levels of Fatigue.
Leg broken: counts as having one leg until repaired. Knocked Prone and Stunned for 2 rounds.
Lower leg torn away. Immediate Challenging (+0) Toughness Test or die from shock. Blood Loss and [[1d5]] permanent Agility Damage.
The target dies. His screams drown out all conversation within [[2d10]] metres for the rest of the round.
